$comment: Registry of the Railway project's services and environments.
Single source of truth for the IDs that used to be copy-pasted into
Services are addressed by ID: stable across a rename in the dashboard.
Environments are addressed by NAME, because the Railway CLI resolves
--environment by name only — passing an ID fails with
'Environment "<id>" not found'. The IDs are kept here for reference.
If an environment is renamed in Railway, change its 'name' here.
